headline: India says Hasina not allowed political activities from its soil
summary: The Indian government has informed parliament that former Bangladeshi PM Sheikh Hasina cannot use Indian territory for political purposes.
details: The Indian government has officially informed its parliament that former Bangladeshi Prime Minister Sheikh Hasina is not permitted to engage in political activities from Indian soil.
This statement comes as India reviews a request from the interim government of Bangladesh regarding the extradition of the former prime minister.
The Indian government's position on political activities was clarified in a report presented to the Lok Sabha, the lower house of the Indian parliament.
The move signals a shift in how New Delhi is managing the presence of the former leader in India following her departure from Bangladesh in August.
Meanwhile, Bangladesh's request for her return to face legal proceedings is currently under review by Indian authorities.
caption:
No political activities from Indian soil. India has set a strict limit for former PM Sheikh Hasina.

The Indian government has officially informed its parliament that former Bangladeshi Prime Minister Sheikh Hasina is not permitted to engage in political activities from Indian soil.

This statement comes as India reviews a request from the interim government of Bangladesh regarding the extradition of the former prime minister.

The Indian government's position on political activities was clarified in a report presented to the Lok Sabha, the lower house of the Indian parliament.

The move signals a shift in how New Delhi is managing the presence of the former leader in India following her departure from Bangladesh in August.

Meanwhile, Bangladesh's request for her return to face legal proceedings is currently under review by Indian authorities.

Source: Dhaka Tribune, Prothom Alo, The Daily Star, Jamuna TV

headline: 50 people including Sarjis Alam filed with attempted murder case in Habiganj
summary: Jatiyotabadi Chhatra Dal has filed a complaint against NCP leader Nasiruddin Patwari, Sarjis Alam, and others following clashes in Habiganj.
details: Jatiyotabadi Chhatra Dal has filed an attempted murder case against 50 people, including NCP leader Nasiruddin Patwari and Sarjis Alam.
The case was filed in Habiganj following clashes between the NCP and Chhatra Dal.
The complaint alleges that the accused individuals were involved in the attack on Chhatra Dal members.
The authorities are now investigating the case to identify and further verify the accused parties.

The authorities are now investigating the case to identify and further verify the accused parties.
